description: Importing NANSEN dev file adapters (adapters.import with a dev adapter instead of a document): a class subclassing nansen.dataio.FileAdapter (its .m file) and a function-based adapter (its +Name folder with fileadapter.json, read.m and write.m) become project file adapters with legacyFileAdapter, MATLAB only, their code copied into matlab/ in the same packages; the title, description (Description, or the help text), extensions (SUPPORTED_FILE_TYPES as written, with or without the dot) and data type are read from the text. A folder of them brings those that are adapters and names the others. A function, a class built on another of dev's adapters and a missing file are refused; an id that is taken is refused, also for a folder, and nothing is written then.
